title: Black Whale exterior blockout
purpose: Create an interactive, evidence-labeled macro exterior envelope without converting working geometry into canon.

coordinateConvention.rule: Coordinates support rendering and comparison only; they do not become evidence.

confirmedMacroClaims: The vessel has a whale-shaped main exterior hull.
A distinct Tier 1 cruise-vessel mass sits above the lower inhabited structure.
The inhabited structure is organized into five vertically ordered tiers.
The exterior encloses large rectilinear inhabited volumes.
A canonical cutaway supports broad tier order and envelope relationships but not exact dimensions.
quarantinedClaims: Exact overall length, beam, draft, hull curvature and underside profile.
Exact correspondence between Tier 1 plan north and ship bow.
Exact deck heights or metric boundaries between tiers.
Exact count, diameter, placement and engineering of spring/support structures.
Exact positions and dimensions of hull openings, launch outlets, windows and stairways.

objectClasses.meaning: Broad existence or placement is directly supported.
Geometry closes unseen surfaces for rendering and must remain visibly labeled as reconstruction.
Explanatory tier or scale volume that is not literal architecture.
Unsourced interior or exterior volume that must remain unfilled and non-navigable.
A known concept or region whose position or dimensions remain unresolved.

plannedObjects.modelingPermission: Create a low-resolution whale-shaped working envelope.
Create a simplified upper-vessel mass with unresolved global orientation.
prohibitions: Do not align Tier 1 room plan to bow

plannedObjects.modelingPermission: Create five broad stacked analytical bands.
Render as void, muted volume or uncertainty field.
prohibitions: Do not fill with generic architecture or machinery

plannedObjects.modelingPermission: Show only an abstract region marker until evidence stabilizes.

roadmapBoundary: Phase 7.4 and all later milestones are prohibited until explicit user instruction.
